name: Digital China Information Service Company Ltd.
summary: Digital China Information Service Company Ltd., headquartered in Shenzhen, People's Republic of China, serves as a comprehensive provider of technological solutions and services. The company caters to a diverse range of sectors, including financial institutions, government entities, general enterprises, telecommunications operators, agricultural businesses, and manufacturing firms. Its core offerings encompass several key domains. Foremost are its advanced technical services, which include strategic IT planning and consultation, robust system operation and maintenance, rigorous quality assurance testing, outsourced IT management, sophisticated data processing capabilities, and cloud computing solutions. In the realm of agricultural informatization, the company specializes in services such as the verification of rural land rights, streamlining rural property rights transfers, and conducting credit investigations for rural land. It also develops smart rural area software, implements agricultural Internet of Things (IoT) systems, utilizes agricultural technology big data, provides certification for agricultural product traceability, and offers financial support services tailored for the agricultural sector. Furthermore, Digital China Information Service is proficient in application software development, delivering end-to-end professional services that span the design, creation, rigorous testing, and ongoing maintenance of various business applications. The company also supplies specialized financial equipment, primarily focusing on the design, production, sales, upkeep, and operational support of Automated Teller Machines (ATMs), alongside providing associated technical services to a wide array of financial institutions, including city commercial, rural commercial, and joint-equity banks. Rounding out its portfolio, the company provides integrated solutions for IT infrastructure, covering its establishment, continuous operation, and meticulous maintenance management. This extends to a full spectrum of informatization services, from the acquisition and installation of IT infrastructure products and systems to their precise debugging, seamless integration, and perpetual maintenance.
